title: Consistent things across locations- please add on
content: Things that were consistent for me no matter where I am in mall world-- feel free to add in the comments! I want to get a list going. - crystals in the sand/on beaches - gift shops - long twisting hallways - underground very dusty tunnels/caves - difficulty being able to see/stay asleep the further I go up levels/upstairs (I can last what feels like 3 minutes in the 3rd floor, and 1 minute in an attic before I wake up, but below that is fine) - public transit system - city blocks - ability to float forward, but I had to learn over time to control it (IRL years, many dreams) - ability to read is diminished. Now I can read some, but it looks jumbled. - no (or rare) physical contact with dream characters. If physical contact is made, they act lucid (surprised to see me, holding me back, shocked that I can read or have been there before, etc) - occasionally glimpsing a map within the dream, and it makes sense in the moment - ability to remember what happened the last time I was at that location -no money when shopping - lots of clothes and clothing stores - arcades -dirty bathrooms -water parks - a fast moving river - bathrooms with no stalls or too many stalls - dormitories/barracks If I think of any more I'll add
